title: Can I BEAT Chess Survivors?
summary: Chess Survivors (turn-based Vampire-Survivors-like 'chess roguelike'): he plays as the Joker (350 max HP, 60 melee, moves 1 square any direction, starting ability Cribbage - shoots pegs in horizontal lines alternating direction). Each act has a turn limit (Act 1: 200 turns, Act 2: 150, Act 3: 100) with an optional turn timer; chess-piece enemies (pawns, giant key-carrying pawns, rooks, bishops) swarm on a tiled arena. Movement coins grant temporary movement as a bishop/rook/queen/knight; level-ups offer abilities (Snow Day, Bullseye, Nightmare, Bubbles, damage/area upgrades); golden chests give relics (Amulet of Slapjack, Witch's Brew, Queen of Diamonds, Mini Magic Mushroom). He finishes the run in 29 minutes and unlocks new characters (tiny wizard, cat); endless mode exists.
rules: Turn-based on a tiled arena: each turn you move your hero (pattern depends on character / collected movement coin) and abilities fire automatically on cooldown; optional turn timer auto-ends the turn.
Hero (Joker): 350 HP, 60 melee damage, moves 1 square any direction; ability Cribbage: pegs shot in horizontal lines, alternating directions.
Movement pickups: bishop/rook/king-like coins temporarily change how you move (e.g. king coin moves like a queen).
Enemies are chess pieces moving with their chess patterns; they damage you when they hit you; giant pawns carry keys (kill the pawn to get the key).

XP bar -> level-up choice: Snow Day (blizzard over an enemy, freezes and damages each turn; damage on frozen enemies doubles), Bullseye (target around you created when you move, bigger the further you move), Nightmare (auto-targets knight-pattern tiles, rotating), Bubbles, +25 damage, +area.

Golden chests -> relics: Amulet of Slapjack (-1 ability cooldown, -42% area), low-health relic (+50 ability damage, +20% damage reduction at 25% HP), Queen of Diamonds (+30% max HP gained on level up), Mini Magic Mushroom (level up twice), Witch's Brew; a 'wandering bot' companion.
Acts: Act 1 200 turns, Act 2 150 turns, Act 3 100 turns; survive to the end (boss fights); endless mode available.
win_condition: Survive all acts' turn counts and beat the bosses (run completed in 29 min).
